errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.sub: Enter the email address your astrologer invited. We will send you a sign-in link and a code.
signIn.noPassword: No password needed. The link and the code work once, for 15 minutes.
signIn.checkSub: If {email} has access to a client portal, a sign-in link and a six-digit code are on their way. Open the link, or type the code here.
signIn.tooMany: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.

link.title: Sign in to your portal
link.sub: Press the button to finish signing in on this device.
link.invalid: Sign-in links work once, for 15 minutes. Ask for a new one — it only takes a moment.

invitation.title: Your client portal
invitation.sub: {practice} invited you to see your appointments and what they share with you, in one private place.
invitation.switching: You are signed in as {email}. Accepting signs you in with the invited address instead.
invitation.privacy: {practice} decides what you see here. You sign in with a link or code sent to your address — there is no password.

expired.title: This invitation has expired
expired.body: Invitations work for seven days. Ask {practice} to send you a new one.

used.title: This invitation was already accepted
used.body: Sign in with your email address to open your portal.

revoked.title: This invitation is no longer valid
revoked.body: A newer invitation may have been sent — use the latest email from {practice}.

unavailable.title: This invitation cannot be used now

failed.title: This invitation could not be accepted
failed.body: It may have expired or been used meanwhile. Please contact {practice}.

missing.title: Open the link from your email
missing.body: This page needs the full link from your invitation email. If you already accepted it, sign in instead.

choose.title: Choose a practice
choose.sub: Your address has access to more than one practice. Each one opens on its own.

noAccess.title: Your portal is not open at the moment
noAccess.body: There is no practice you can open right now. If you think this is a mistake, please contact your astrologer.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: There is nothing at this address.

home.zoneOffer: Times are shown in the practice's time zone ({practice}). Your device is set to {device}.
home.zoneSaved: Times are now shown in your time zone.
home.noNext: No appointment is booked at the moment.
home.moreUpcoming: and {count} more upcoming appointment | and {count} more upcoming appointments
home.newShared: new since your last visit | new since your last visit
home.bookHint: Choose a service and a free time that suits you.

appointments.contact: To change this appointment, please contact the practice.

until.both: You can reschedule or cancel here until {when}.

appointments.tooLate: This appointment can no longer be changed here. Please contact the practice.
appointments.notChangeable: This appointment cannot be changed any more.
appointments.closed: Changes in the portal are not open at the moment. Please contact the practice.
appointments.missing: This appointment cannot be found among your upcoming appointments.
appointments.rescheduleSub: Choose a new time. The service, length and place stay as they are.
appointments.movedRequested: It still waits for the practice to confirm it.
appointments.unchanged: Nothing changed — your appointment already has this time.
appointments.maybeMoved: This change may already have gone through — please check your appointments.

booking.title: Book an appointment

sub.service: Choose what you would like to book.
sub.time: Choose a free time that suits you.

booking.priceNote: Prices are shown for information. Nothing is paid here.
booking.deposit: The practice asks for a deposit for this service.
booking.disabled: Booking in the portal is not open at the moment. Please contact the practice to make an appointment.
booking.noServices: There is nothing to book in the portal at the moment. Please contact the practice.
booking.noTimes: No free times in the next {count} day. | No free times in the next {count} days.
booking.noTimesHint: Please look again later, or contact the practice.
booking.where: How would you like to meet?
booking.whereRequired: Please choose online or in person.

rules.none: Changes are made only through the practice.
rules.both: You can reschedule or cancel here until the appointment starts. | You can reschedule or cancel here until {count} hour before the appointment. | You can reschedule or cancel here until {count} hours before the appointment.
rules.reschedule: You can reschedule here until the appointment starts. | You can reschedule here until {count} hour before the appointment. | You can reschedule here until {count} hours before the appointment.
rules.cancel: You can cancel here until the appointment starts. | You can cancel here until {count} hour before the appointment. | You can cancel here until {count} hours before the appointment.
rules.rescheduleNone: To reschedule, please contact the practice.
rules.cancelNone: To cancel, please contact the practice.

booking.requestHint: The practice confirms the time first. You will get an email when they do.
booking.slotTaken: That time was just taken — please pick another.
booking.serviceGone: This service can no longer be booked here. Please choose another one.
booking.tooMany: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
booking.tooManyOpen: You already have several upcoming appointments. Please contact the practice to book more.
booking.maybeBooked: This booking may already have gone through — please check your appointments.
booking.requested: Request sent — the practice will confirm it by email.

shared.sub: Notes, files and links {practice} shared with you.
shared.empty: Nothing has been shared with you yet.
shared.title: Shared with you

profile.emailHint: To change your address, please ask {practice}.
profile.timezoneHint: Appointment times are shown in this zone.
profile.reminders: Remind me a day before each appointment
profile.remindersHint: Sent the same way as your other notices. Notices about booking, moving and cancelling come either way.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.isOn: Notifications are on for this device.
notifications.isOff: Notifications are off for this device.
notifications.turnedOn: Notifications are on for this device.
notifications.turnedOff: Notifications are off for this device.
notifications.notAllowed: Notifications were not allowed. You can try again at any time.
notifications.testSent: Test notification sent. It should appear in a moment.
notifications.testFailed: The test notification could not be delivered. If this keeps happening, turn notifications on again for this device.
notifications.generic: A notification says only what happened and when. The details open in the portal.
notifications.others: Also on for {count} other device: {devices}. | Also on for {count} other devices: {devices}.
notifications.channelHint: If none of your devices can receive notifications, notices come by email.
notifications.byEmail: Notices about your appointments come by email to {email}.

states.insecure: Notifications need a secure (https) connection to the portal.
states.installFirst: On iPhone and iPad, notifications work only in the installed app (iOS 16.4 or later). Tap Share, then Add to Home Screen, open the portal from your Home Screen and turn notifications on there.
states.unsupported: This browser cannot show notifications from the portal. Notices come by email.
states.denied: Notifications are blocked for this site. To allow them, open the site settings in your browser (usually the icon next to the address) and allow notifications, then reload this page. In the installed app, allow them in your device's settings for the app.

problems.unavailable: Notifications are not available at the moment. Notices come by email.
problems.service: This browser's notifications are not supported. Please try another browser.
problems.notOn: Notifications are not on for this device any more.
problems.tooMany: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
problems.failed: Notifications could not be turned on. Please try again.

install.title: App
install.homeTitle: Use the portal as an app
install.lead: Install the portal on this device. It opens from your home screen like an app.
install.installed: The app is installed. Open it from your home screen or your list of apps.
install.iosSteps: Tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.
install.iosNote: Notifications on iPhone and iPad need the installed app (iOS 16.4 or later).
install.hint: If your browser offers it, you can add the portal to your home screen or dock from the browser's menu.

security.sub: You sign in as {email}, with a link or code sent to that address.
security.everywhereHint: Signs you out on every device, this one too. You can sign in again with a new link.
security.confirm: Sign out on every device, this one too?
